More surprisingly, a hobby may reveal talents we never knew we had, and sometimes even point to a future career. College is the best time to explore. Find something you love, and your life will shine.

writing.title: Honesty in Examinations
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 80-100 words on cheating in exams. You should analyze its causes and harms and state your attitude toward honesty.
writing.promptZh: 分析考试作弊的原因与危害，表明对诚信考试的态度。
outline: 第一段：现象——仍有学生铤而走险作弊
第二段：原因（虚荣心、平时不努力）与危害（欺骗自己、失去信任、校纪处分）
第三段：态度——诚实比分数更重要
writing.model: Every exam season brings news of students caught cheating with small notes or phones. Why do they take such risks? Mostly out of laziness and vanity: they want high marks without honest effort. However, cheating does far more harm than good. To begin with, it fools no one but the cheater himself, because a stolen score hides real weaknesses that will surface sooner or later. Worse still, once caught, a student loses both the score and, more painfully, the trust of teachers and classmates. Honesty is the passport of a person. In my eyes, a truthful 60 is far more respectable than a dishonest 100.

expressions.en: Honesty is the passport of a person.
expressions.zh: 诚实是一个人的通行证。

writing.title: Will AI Replace Human Creativity?
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on whether artificial intelligence will replace human creativity. You should present a clear viewpoint and support it with reasons.
writing.promptZh: 论述人工智能是否会取代人类创造力，表明观点并给出理由。
outline: 第一段：引出AI绘画、写作引发的争议，亮明观点
第二段：论证——AI擅长模仿组合，但缺乏真实情感与生活体验；AI可作工具放大创造力
第三段：结论——AI是助手而非替代者，人类应保持主体性
writing.model: The rise of generative AI has alarmed many artists and writers, who fear that machines will steal their creativity. In my view, however, AI can imitate creativity but never replace it. What AI excels at is recombining existing patterns at astonishing speed; what it lacks is genuine experience. A poem written by an algorithm may rhyme perfectly, yet it springs from no heartbreak, no joy and no memory of a childhood summer. True creativity is rooted in human feelings and lived life. That said, we should not reject AI. Used wisely, it frees us from repetitive work and enlarges our imagination. The wise choice is to let AI serve as a tool while humans remain the masters of creation.

writing.title: The Value of Critical Thinking
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on the importance of critical thinking in the information age. Explain what it means and how college students can cultivate it.
writing.promptZh: 论述信息时代批判性思维的重要性，解释其含义并说明大学生如何培养。
outline: 第一段：信息爆炸时代，观点泥沙俱下，批判性思维尤为珍贵
第二段：内涵（质疑、求证、多角度分析）与培养方法（多问为什么、核查信源、与不同观点辩论）
第三段：总结——独立思考是成熟 intellect 的标志
writing.model: We live in an age when opinions flood our screens, and false news often spreads faster than truth. In such a world, critical thinking is no longer a luxury but a necessity. It means refusing to swallow information whole: questioning sources, weighing evidence and examining a problem from different angles before forming a judgment. College students can cultivate it in daily life. When reading a hot post, we should ask who wrote it, what evidence supports it and whose voice is missing. In class, arguing respectfully with classmates who hold different views sharpens our logic. Critical thinking does not make us negative; rather, it keeps us clear-headed and truly free in a noisy world.

expressions.en: no longer a luxury but a necessity
expressions.zh: 不再是奢侈品而是必需品

writing.title: Innovation Requires Cooperation
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on the relationship between innovation and cooperation. You should argue why modern innovation can hardly be achieved by a single genius.
writing.promptZh: 论述创新与合作的关系，说明为什么现代创新难以靠个人天才完成。
outline: 第一段：破除迷思——创新不只是孤独天才的灵光一现
第二段：论证（现代问题复杂需跨学科协作；团队中思想碰撞激发创意；举例科研团队）
第三段：总结——学会合作是创新者的必修课
writing.model: When we think of innovation, the image of a lonely genius struck by sudden inspiration often comes to mind. Yet most breakthroughs today are born of teamwork rather than solitude. The problems facing modern society — from curing diseases to developing clean energy — are so complex that no single mind can master all the knowledge required. A biologist, an engineer and a data analyst working together can see what none of them sees alone. Moreover, cooperation itself sparks innovation: when different ideas collide, unexpected solutions often emerge. The history of science confirms this, from the human genome project to vaccine development. Therefore, learning to cooperate is a compulsory course for anyone who dreams of creating something new.

writing.title: Surviving the Age of Information Overload
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on information overload. Describe the phenomenon, analyze its negative effects and suggest how to cope with it.
writing.promptZh: 描述信息过载现象及其负面影响，并提出应对之策。
outline: 第一段：现象——信息量爆炸，注意力被无限切割
第二段：危害（焦虑、浅思考、判断力下降）
第三段：对策（筛选信源、深度阅读、定期数字断舍离）
writing.model: Every day we are bombarded with news, posts, videos and advertisements, and the amount of information we consume in a week may exceed what people in the last century absorbed in a lifetime. This information overload brings hidden costs. Our attention is cut into fragments, making deep thinking increasingly difficult; endless updates fuel anxiety and the fear of missing out; and with so many voices competing, our own judgment grows weak. To survive this age, we must become selective. I suggest choosing a few reliable sources instead of scanning everything, setting fixed times for checking messages, and reading one serious book each month to train our concentration. Information is a river; the wise build channels rather than drown in it.

expressions.en: build channels rather than drown in it
expressions.zh: 修建渠道而非被其淹没

writing.title: Lifelong Learning in a Changing World
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on lifelong learning. Explain why learning should not stop after graduation and how we can keep learning throughout life.
writing.promptZh: 论述为何学习不应止于毕业，以及如何在人生中持续学习。
outline: 第一段：知识更新加速，毕业不等于学习结束
第二段：原因（职业更替、技术迭代、个人成长）与途径（在线课程、阅读、向他人学习、复盘）
第三段：总结——把学习当成生活方式
writing.model: In the past, a university degree could serve a person for a whole career. Today, however, knowledge doubles every few years, and occupations that never existed a decade ago are now hiring in large numbers. This means that the day we stop learning is the day we begin to fall behind. Lifelong learning is not only demanded by the job market; it also keeps our minds young and our lives interesting. Fortunately, learning has never been more accessible. Online courses allow us to study with top professors at home, reading offers conversations with great minds, and even daily reflection turns experience into wisdom. Graduation should be seen not as the end of education, but as the beginning of a longer, self-directed one.

writing.title: Facing an Aging Society
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on the challenge of an aging society. Analyze its impacts and suggest what the society and young people can do.
writing.promptZh: 分析老龄化社会带来的影响，并从社会与青年人角度提出应对建议。
outline: 第一段：背景——老年人口比例上升，老龄化成为现实
第二段：影响（劳动力减少、养老医疗压力）与机遇（银发经济、经验传承）
第三段：建议——完善养老体系，年轻人关爱老人、提前规划
writing.model: China is aging at a speed rarely seen in history. Within a few decades, nearly one third of the population will be over sixty. This trend brings serious challenges: a shrinking workforce, heavier pressure on pension and medical systems, and millions of elderly parents living apart from their children. Yet aging is not purely a burden. Retired people carry valuable experience, and the "silver economy" — from health care to tourism for seniors — is creating new industries and jobs. To meet this challenge, the government should improve the pension system and community-based care, while we young people ought to visit our parents more often and learn to plan our own future early. An aging society tests not only our economy, but also our conscience.

writing.title: The Pros and Cons of Urbanization
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on urbanization. Discuss both its benefits and the problems it creates, and give your view on how cities can develop in a healthier way.
writing.promptZh: 讨论城市化的利与弊，并就城市如何健康发展表达观点。
outline: 第一段：背景——城市化快速推进，人口涌入城市
第二段：利（就业、教育医疗资源）与弊（拥堵、房价、污染、乡愁）
第三段：观点——规划先行，绿色智慧，让城市宜居
writing.model: Over the past forty years, hundreds of millions of Chinese have moved from the countryside into cities, and the skyline keeps rising. Urbanization has undeniably fueled economic growth: cities concentrate factories, universities and hospitals, offering people better jobs and services. However, the costs are equally visible. Traffic jams waste hours every day, housing prices swallow young people's savings, and air pollution threatens public health. Meanwhile, many villages are left with only the old and the young. In my opinion, the future of urbanization lies in quality rather than speed. Cities should invest in public transport and green spaces, while the countryside deserves better infrastructure so that people have a real choice. A great city is not measured by its tallest building, but by the happiness of its ordinary residents.

expressions.en: lie in quality rather than speed

writing.title: Carrying Traditional Culture to the World
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on how to promote Chinese traditional culture to the world. Explain its value and suggest concrete ways to tell China's stories well.
writing.promptZh: 论述向世界传播中华传统文化的价值，并提出讲好中国故事的具体方式。
outline: 第一段：背景——全球化下文化影响力日益重要，传统文化是我们的根
第二段：价值（身份认同、智慧资源）与传播方式（现代媒介、文创产品、青年交流）
第三段：总结——让传统活起来、走出去
writing.model: As China steps onto the center of the world stage, its five-thousand-year culture attracts growing curiosity. Promoting traditional culture is not about showing off the past; it is about sharing wisdom that still speaks to modern life, from the harmony between man and nature to the value of family and learning. How, then, can we tell China's stories well? First, let old culture wear new clothes: short videos, games and animated films can make Peking opera or ancient poetry attractive to global youth. Second, cultural products such as Hanfu and museum souvenirs carry stories across borders without a single word of preaching. Third, every student abroad or online is a cultural ambassador. When tradition lives in daily life, it naturally travels to the world.

writing.title: On Cultural Confidence
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on cultural confidence. Explain what it means, why it matters for a nation and how young people can build it.
writing.promptZh: 阐述文化自信的内涵与意义，说明青年如何树立文化自信。
outline: 第一段：定义——文化自信是对自身文化价值的认同与自豪
第二段：意义（民族凝聚力、创新源泉、对话底气）；非盲目自大
第三段：青年做法——深入学习、理性比较、开放包容
writing.model: Cultural confidence means a nation's deep recognition of and pride in its own cultural values. It is not blind arrogance, nor is it the belief that everything foreign is superior. A people without confidence in their own culture are like a tree without roots: they may sway with every wind. For China, cultural confidence matters because it holds the nation together, feeds innovation with ancient wisdom, and gives us an equal voice in global dialogue. Young people can build such confidence in three ways: studying classics seriously rather than merely quoting them, comparing cultures rationally to see both strengths and weaknesses, and embracing foreign cultures openly, for confidence never fears exchange. Only those who know where they come from can walk far into the future.

writing.title: Sustainable Development: Our Only Choice
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on sustainable development. Explain the concept, why the traditional growth model is unsustainable, and what individuals can contribute.
writing.promptZh: 解释可持续发展的理念，说明传统增长模式为何不可持续，以及个人能做什么。
outline: 第一段：概念——既满足当代需求又不损害后代的发展
第二段：论证传统模式之弊（资源枯竭、气候变化）与绿色转型的必要性
第三段：个人行动——低碳生活、绿色消费、传播理念
writing.model: Sustainable development, as defined by the United Nations, meets the needs of the present without sacrificing the ability of future generations to meet their own. This concept has become urgent because the traditional growth model — burning fossil fuels, cutting forests and consuming resources at breakneck speed — has already pushed the planet to its limits. Climate change, disappearing species and polluted rivers warn us that nature keeps accounts, and the bill is falling due. Nations are responding with clean energy and green industry, but individuals matter equally. We can choose public transport, refuse over-packaged goods, save water and electricity, and support companies that respect the environment. Small daily choices, multiplied by billions, decide whether development can truly last.

expressions.en: sacrifice the ability of future generations

writing.title: Mental Health Matters as Much as Physical Health
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on mental health among young people. Analyze why it is often neglected and suggest ways to improve the situation.
writing.promptZh: 分析年轻人心理健康常被忽视的原因，并提出改善建议。
outline: 第一段：现象——焦虑抑郁高发，但心理问题仍被污名化
第二段：原因（病耻感、竞争压力、缺乏倾诉渠道）与对策（正视求助、学校咨询、健康作息、社会去污名）
第三段：总结——心灵健康与身体健康同等重要
writing.model: Surveys show that anxiety and depression are rising among young people, yet many still hide their struggles, fearing to be labeled weak. This silence makes matters worse. Mental health is often neglected for three reasons: the shame attached to psychological problems, fierce competition from school and the job market, and a lack of channels to express true feelings. To improve the situation, we must first change our attitude — seeking help from a counselor is as normal as seeing a dentist for a toothache. Universities should make psychological services more accessible, while social media ought to stop glorifying endless overtime and perfect lives. Most importantly, everyone deserves a break. A healthy mind in a healthy body — neither half can be sacrificed for the other.

writing.title: Choosing Between Employment and Further Study
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on whether graduates should find a job or pursue postgraduate study. Analyze both options and give your own view.
writing.promptZh: 分析毕业直接就业与考研深造两种选择，并给出自己的看法。
outline: 第一段：现象——考研热持续升温，就业与深造成为难题
第二段：比较两者（深造：学术深化、门槛提升；就业：经济独立、经验积累）；关键是匹配自身规划
第三段：观点——拒绝盲从，理性选择
writing.model: Each year, millions of graduates face the same crossroads: to hunt for a job or to prepare for postgraduate entrance exams. The "exam fever" suggests that many choose the latter simply to delay employment or follow the crowd. Both paths have their logic. Further study deepens professional knowledge and opens doors to research positions that require higher degrees; working early, on the other hand, brings financial independence and precious experience that classrooms cannot teach. Therefore, the right answer depends not on fashion but on one's own goals. Students who love academic research and need a master's degree for their dream career should study on; those eager to test themselves in the market should not feel ashamed to work. The worst choice is one made blindly, in someone else's direction.

expressions.en: depend not on fashion but on one's own goals
expressions.zh: 取决于自身目标而非潮流

writing.title: Globalization in the Digital Age
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on how the digital age has changed globalization. Discuss its opportunities and risks for young people.
writing.promptZh: 论述数字时代全球化的新变化，及其给年轻人带来的机遇与风险。
outline: 第一段：数字技术让全球化进入新阶段——货物之外，数据与思想即时流动
第二段：机遇（远程工作、跨文化学习、全球市场）与风险（文化同质化、数字鸿沟、信息壁垒）
第三段：建议——青年应具备全球视野与本土根基
writing.model: Globalization once meant container ships carrying goods across oceans. Today it travels through fiber cables: an idea posted in Beijing can be discussed in New York within minutes, and a programmer in Chengdu can work for a company in Berlin without leaving home. This digital globalization offers young people unprecedented opportunities — global markets, cross-cultural friendships and knowledge that is almost free. Yet risks come along. Cultures may be flattened into sameness by a few dominant platforms, and those without digital skills risk being left behind. The wisest attitude, I believe, is to think globally while staying rooted locally: embrace the world's diversity with open arms, and never let the noise of the internet drown out our own voice.

expressions.en: think globally while staying rooted locally

writing.title: Technology Should Serve Humanity
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on the ethical use of technology. Give examples of technology's double effects and argue why ethics must guide innovation.
writing.promptZh: 结合技术的双重效应举例，论述为何伦理必须引导科技创新。
outline: 第一段：技术飞速进步，但伦理追问滞后
第二段：举例（算法推荐致信息茧房、人脸识别侵犯隐私、AI造假）说明技术双刃剑属性
第三段：观点——科技向善，伦理与法律须为创新立规
writing.model: Technology advances at lightning speed, while ethical thinking often lags behind. Algorithms that recommend what we like trap us in information cocoons; facial recognition brings convenience but also threatens privacy; and AI can now forge voices and videos that are almost impossible to detect. None of these tools is evil in itself, yet without guidance, they can serve profit at the cost of human dignity. That is why ethics must steer innovation. Companies should be held responsible for the social effects of their products, laws must keep pace with new technologies, and users should stay alert rather than surrender blindly. Technology is a powerful engine; ethics is the steering wheel. An engine without a wheel leads only to a faster crash.

expressions.en: at the cost of human dignity

writing.title: Stop the Spread of Online Rumors
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on online rumors. Analyze why rumors spread so fast, what harm they cause, and how netizens should respond.
writing.promptZh: 分析网络谣言传播快的原因与危害，并提出网民应对之策。
outline: 第一段：现象——谣言传播速度远超真相
第二段：原因（情绪驱动、流量利益、核实成本）与危害（伤害当事人、扰乱秩序、侵蚀信任）
第三段：对策——不轻信、不转发、等真相、举报
writing.model: A lie can travel halfway around the world while the truth is still putting on its shoes. In the digital age, this old saying has become painfully real: rumors about disasters, public figures or even ordinary citizens spread within hours, often fueled by emotion and the traffic-hungry pursuit of clicks. The harm is serious. Rumors damage reputations that take years to build, mislead public opinion, and erode the trust on which society depends. As netizens, we should form good habits: pause before forwarding, check whether the source is reliable, and wait for official confirmation on breaking news. When we meet obvious fabrications, reporting them is a civic duty. Restraint costs nothing, but it protects everything.

expressions.en: A lie can travel halfway around the world.
expressions.zh: 谎言可传遍半个世界（谣言跑得快）。

writing.title: Deep Reading in a Fragmented Age
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on the value of deep reading. Explain why fragmented reading is not enough and how to cultivate the habit of deep reading.
writing.promptZh: 论述深度阅读的价值，说明碎片化阅读的不足及如何养成深读习惯。
outline: 第一段：现象——刷屏式碎片阅读取代整本书阅读
第二段：碎片阅读的局限（知识零散、思考浅表）与深读的价值（系统思维、专注力、共情）
第三段：方法——固定时段、远离手机、做笔记
writing.model: Five-minute summaries of classics and knowledge clips on short videos have become many people's daily diet. Such fragmented reading gives the illusion of learning, yet scattered information seldom turns into wisdom. Deep reading — spending hours with a serious book — trains what fragments cannot: sustained concentration, systematic thinking and the ability to enter another person's inner world. Research even suggests that people who read literature deeply are better at understanding others. To rebuild this habit, we can reserve a fixed half hour each day for paper books, leave the phone in another room, and take notes or discuss what we read. In an age that chops everything into pieces, the ability to read deeply is itself a form of resistance.

writing.title: The Spirit of Craftsmanship
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on the spirit of craftsmanship. Explain what it means and why modern society, despite its speed, still needs it.
writing.promptZh: 阐释工匠精神的内涵，论述追求速度的现代社会为何仍需要它。
outline: 第一段：定义——专注、精益、敬业、追求卓越
第二段：论证其价值（品质与信任、创新的基础、对抗浮躁）并举例
第三段：青年启示——无论做什么，都力求做到极致
writing.model: The spirit of craftsmanship refers to a devotion to one's work: patience with details, pursuit of excellence, and the willingness to polish a single thing for decades. In an era that worships speed, some dismiss it as outdated. I strongly disagree. Products made with care earn lasting trust, which is why time-honored brands survive while hasty imitations vanish. Moreover, craftsmanship is the soil of innovation: breakthroughs come not from those who change direction every month, but from those who dig one well deep enough to reach water. For young people, this spirit offers an antidote to restlessness. Whatever we choose to do — writing code, cooking a meal or conducting an experiment — doing it to the best of our ability is itself a form of dignity.

writing.title: Low-carbon Life Starts with Small Steps
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on low-carbon lifestyles. Explain the significance of carbon reduction and describe what ordinary people can do in daily life.
writing.promptZh: 论述低碳生活的意义，并说明普通人在日常生活中能做什么。
outline: 第一段：背景——气候变化紧迫，双碳目标需要全民参与
第二段：个人行动（公共交通、节约能源、减少浪费、二手循环）看似微小实则可观
第三段：总结——低碳是生活方式而非口号
writing.model: With extreme weather making headlines year after year, cutting carbon emissions has moved from scientists' reports into everyone's daily life. China's goal of carbon neutrality cannot be achieved by governments and factories alone; the choices of over a billion ordinary people matter just as much. Fortunately, low-carbon living is simpler than it sounds. Taking a bus or a shared bike instead of driving, turning off idle electronics, finishing the food on our plates, and buying second-hand items instead of new ones — each act trims our carbon footprint a little. If every family saves one kilowatt-hour a day, the total is staggering. Low-carbon life is not a slogan for special occasions; it is a quiet habit that respects the planet we borrow from our children.

writing.title: Young People and Rural Revitalization
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on the role of young people in rural revitalization. Explain why the countryside needs youth and what young people can gain in return.
writing.promptZh: 论述青年在乡村振兴中的作用：乡村为何需要青年，青年又能收获什么。
outline: 第一段：背景——乡村振兴成为国家战略，但农村空心化、缺人才
第二段：青年的贡献（新理念、电商直播、现代农业技术）与收获（广阔舞台、人生价值）
第三段：总结——把青春写在大地上
writing.model: While cities compete for graduates, many villages are left with the elderly and children, short of both labor and new ideas. Rural revitalization, therefore, urgently needs young blood. Young people bring exactly what the countryside lacks: knowledge of e-commerce that turns local fruit into nationwide best-sellers, modern farming techniques that raise harvests, and fresh thinking that revives dying folk crafts. In return, the countryside offers young people something cities cannot — a vast stage where their work changes real lives immediately, and a deep sense of being needed. Of course, encouraging youth to return requires better infrastructure and policies, but the call of the land has never been louder. Wherever talents go, vitality follows.

writing.title: Busyness Is Not an Achievement
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on today's culture of busyness. Argue why being busy should not be mistaken for being productive, and how to use time wisely.
writing.promptZh: 评论当今以忙碌为荣的风气，论证忙碌不等于高效，并谈谈如何明智地利用时间。
outline: 第一段：现象——人们以忙为荣，把日程填满当作成就
第二段：辨析——伪忙碌（表演性加班、琐事淹没要事）消耗生命；真正的高效源于专注与取舍
第三段：建议——聚焦要事、留白思考、敢于说不
writing.model: "I am so busy" has become a badge of honor, and people proudly compare their packed schedules as if exhaustion measured achievement. This worship of busyness deserves serious doubt. Much of what fills our days is fake productivity: meetings without conclusions, overtime performed for the boss's eyes, and endless scrolling disguised as rest. Real achievement comes from focused effort on what truly matters, and that requires the courage to say no to the trivial. As a management expert once noted, being busy is often a way of avoiding the hard work of thinking about priorities. So let us schedule blanks for reflection, measure our days by progress rather than motion, and remember: it is not how busy we are, but how well we use our hours, that shapes a life.

expressions.zh: 荣誉勋章（值得炫耀的标志）

expressions.en: measure days by progress rather than motion
expressions.zh: 以进步而非忙碌衡量日子

writing.title: A Letter Recommending a Student for an Exchange Program
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a recommendation letter of about 100-120 words to the International Office, recommending your student Wang Fang for a semester exchange program in the UK. Describe her abilities and character.
writing.promptZh: 给国际交流处写一封推荐信，推荐学生王芳参加赴英交换项目，介绍其能力与品格。
outline: 第一段：表明身份与推荐目的
第二段：具体介绍学术能力、英语水平与性格优势（举例支撑）
第三段：重申推荐并表达信心与联系方式
writing.model:
Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to recommend Wang Fang, a sophomore in my English literature class, for the semester exchange program in the United Kingdom. During the past two years, Wang Fang has ranked among the top five percent of her major and shown remarkable ability in critical reading; her essays are always well-argued and original. Her spoken English is fluent, as she has twice won prizes in provincial speech contests. Beyond academics, she is warm-hearted and responsible, having organized several reading clubs for freshmen. I am confident that she will both benefit from and contribute to the exchange program. Please feel free to contact me if you need further information.
Yours sincerely,
Professor Li Hua

expressions.en: rank among the top five percent
Please feel free to contact me.

writing.title: An Email Inviting a Professor to a Seminar
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write an email of about 100-120 words on behalf of your department, inviting Professor Green from Oxford to give a talk at an academic seminar on AI and education. Cover the date, venue, audience and topic suggestions.
writing.promptZh: 以院系名义给牛津大学Green教授发邮件，邀请其在人工智能与教育研讨会上发言，写明时间地点与听众。
outline: 第一段：自我介绍与诚挚邀请，说明研讨会主题与时间
第二段：细节——地点、听众构成、时长、话题建议及差旅安排
第三段：表达期待并请求回复
writing.model:
Dear Professor Green,
I am Li Hua, secretary of the School of Education at Beijing University. On behalf of my department, I sincerely invite you to deliver a keynote talk at our seminar on Artificial Intelligence and the Future of Education, to be held on the morning of May 20 in our main conference hall. Your pioneering research on machine learning in classrooms has inspired many of our faculty and students, and about two hundred graduate students and teachers will attend. A talk of forty-five minutes, followed by discussion, would be ideal; you are welcome to choose any related topic. We will cover your travel and accommodation expenses. We would be deeply honored by your acceptance, and I look forward to your reply.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua

expressions.en: We would be deeply honored by your acceptance.
expressions.zh: 若您接受邀请，我们将深感荣幸。

writing.title: An Apology for Missing an Academic Appointment
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write an email of about 100-120 words to Professor Liu, apologizing for missing your scheduled meeting about your thesis because of a sudden high fever. Explain, apologize and propose a new time.
writing.promptZh: 给刘教授写邮件，为因突发高烧错过论文指导面谈道歉，解释原因并另约时间。
outline: 第一段：为爽约郑重道歉
第二段：解释原因（突发高烧就医）并表达对导师时间的尊重
第三段：提出新的可选时间，恳请谅解
writing.model:
Dear Professor Liu,
Please accept my sincere apologies for missing our meeting yesterday afternoon about my thesis proposal. Late last night I suddenly developed a high fever and was taken to the university hospital, where the doctor diagnosed acute tonsillitis and advised immediate rest. In my dazed state I failed to inform you in advance, and I deeply regret wasting your valuable time. I have attached the medical certificate for your reference. Now that I am recovering, could I visit your office this Thursday or Friday afternoon, whichever suits you better? I have already revised Chapter One according to your previous comments and will bring the draft with me. Once again, I am terribly sorry for any inconvenience caused.
Yours respectfully,
Wang Lin

expressions.en: fail to inform sb. in advance

writing.title: A Proposal on a Campus Reading Festival
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a proposal of about 100-120 words to the university authorities, suggesting that a reading festival be held on campus. State the purpose, planned activities and expected effects.
writing.promptZh: 向学校提议举办校园读书节，说明目的、拟开展的活动与预期效果。
outline: 第一段：提议举办读书节并说明背景与目的
第二段：活动设计（名家讲座、读书分享会、旧书交换、经典诵读）
第三段：预期效果与请求支持
writing.model:
To the University Authorities,
As digital distractions squeeze students' reading time, I propose that our university hold an annual Reading Festival this April. The festival aims to rekindle students' passion for books and build a scholarly atmosphere on campus. Several activities could be arranged: lectures by renowned writers, reading-sharing sessions where students present their favorite books in ten minutes, a second-hand book exchange corner, and morning recitations of classic essays by the lake. Based on similar events at other universities, the festival is expected to attract wide participation, help students form lasting reading habits, and even give birth to reading clubs that continue throughout the year. I earnestly hope the university will consider this proposal and offer its support.
Li Hua, School of Liberal Arts

writing.title: Redefining Success
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on how success should be defined. Criticize the single standard of wealth and fame, and propose your own understanding of success.
writing.promptZh: 批判以财富名望为唯一标准的成功观，阐述自己对成功的理解。
outline: 第一段：现象——社交媒体把成功窄化为财富与名气
第二段：批判单一标准（制造焦虑、误导选择）；成功应多元——尽责、成长、幸福、贡献
第三段：观点——按自己的标准过好一生即成功
writing.model: On social media, success is often reduced to a single image: a young millionaire beside a sports car. This narrow standard does more harm than good. It persuades countless people to abandon what they truly love for well-paid but soulless jobs, and it fills ordinary lives with anxiety, as if a teacher, a nurse or a craftsman could never count as successful. In my view, success should be measured by plural rulers: whether we grow into better versions of ourselves, whether our work benefits others, and whether we find peace and joy in daily life. A scientist advancing knowledge, a parent raising a kind child, and a baker perfecting his bread are all successful in their own way. The highest success is living fully according to one's own values, not someone else's price list.

expressions.zh: 别人开出的价目表（喻世俗标准）

writing.title: Bridging the Generation Gap
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on the generation gap in the digital age. Analyze its causes and suggest how the young and the old can understand each other better.
writing.promptZh: 分析数字时代代沟的成因，并就两代人如何增进理解提出建议。
outline: 第一段：现象——数字鸿沟加深代沟，两代人互相不理解
第二段：成因（成长环境迥异、技术变革过快、交流减少）
第三段：建议——年轻人耐心教长辈用新技术，长辈保持开放；关键是双向奔赴与陪伴
writing.model: The generation gap has always existed, but the digital age has widened it into a chasm. Parents cannot understand why their children stare at screens all day, while the young find their parents' advice hopelessly old-fashioned. Behind this lies more than stubbornness: the two generations grew up in utterly different worlds, and technology now changes faster than experience can keep up with. Bridging the gap takes effort from both sides. Young people should slow down and teach their parents to use smartphones with patience, just as parents once taught them to hold chopsticks. Elders, in turn, may try to appreciate new ways of living instead of dismissing them. Most of all, nothing replaces time spent together. Understanding is not a lecture but a dialogue, and love is its common language.

writing.title: The Value of Failure
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on the value of failure. Argue why fear of failure holds people back and how we should treat setbacks wisely.
writing.promptZh: 论述失败的价值：为何惧怕失败会让人止步不前，以及如何正确对待挫折。
outline: 第一段：现象——人们渴望成功却恐惧失败，不敢尝试
第二段：论证失败的价值（反馈信息、磨砺意志、创新必经之路，举例）
第三段：态度——把失败当学费，复盘再出发
writing.model: Most people say they want success, yet many dare not try, because the fear of failure paralyzes them. This fear misunderstands what failure really is. Failure is not the opposite of success; it is part of it. Every setback carries valuable feedback, telling us precisely where our plans went wrong, and every great invention — from the light bulb to the rocket — stands on a mountain of failed experiments. Moreover, enduring failure builds the resilience that smooth roads never teach. The wise, therefore, treat failure as tuition rather than as a verdict: they review what happened, adjust their approach, and set out again with sharper eyes. A life spent avoiding mistakes may be safe, but it risks being the greatest mistake of all.

expressions.en: treat failure as tuition rather than a verdict
expressions.zh: 把失败当学费而非判决

writing.title: The Sharing Economy: Promise and Problems
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on the sharing economy. Discuss its benefits, the problems it has exposed, and how it can develop healthily.
writing.promptZh: 讨论共享经济的益处与暴露的问题，并谈谈其如何健康发展。
outline: 第一段：现象——共享单车、网约车、共享住宿改变生活
第二段：益处（资源利用率高、便利、绿色）与问题（乱停乱放、押金难退、责任纠纷）
第三段：对策——完善监管、信用体系与企业自律
writing.model: From shared bikes on every corner to ride-hailing apps and home-sharing platforms, the sharing economy has reshaped urban life within a few years. Its benefits are obvious: idle resources are put to use, consumers enjoy cheaper and more flexible services, and sharing reduces waste, which fits the green development trend. Yet the boom has exposed problems too — bikes piled up on sidewalks, deposits hard to get back, and disputes over who should pay when accidents happen. Healthy growth requires joint effort. The government should set clear rules on safety and fund management, platforms must honor their responsibilities instead of chasing expansion alone, and users need to build a culture of trustworthiness. Sharing economy, after all, shares not only goods but also credit — both kinds must be well managed.

writing.title: Dare to Think for Yourself
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on independent thinking. Explain why people tend to follow the crowd and argue the importance of thinking for oneself.
writing.promptZh: 分析人们从众的心理原因，论述独立思考的重要性。
outline: 第一段：现象——热点一来，观点一边倒，人云亦云
第二段：从众原因（省事、怕孤立）与其代价（丧失判断、被操纵）
第三段：倡导——敢持异议、延迟判断、为自己的头脑负责
writing.model: When a hot topic appears online, opinions often rush to one side like water in flood, and few dare to stand apart. Following the crowd feels safe and effortless: it saves us the trouble of research and protects us from isolation. The price, however, is high. A person who always echoes others gradually loses the ability to judge, becoming easy prey for manipulators who know exactly which emotions to stir. Independent thinking does not mean opposing everything for its own sake; it means suspending judgment until evidence arrives, listening to different voices, and forming opinions we can defend with reasons. History honors those who thought differently — from scientists challenging old theories to writers questioning fashionable views. Our minds are the last territory we truly own; let us guard them well.

expressions.en: the last territory we truly own
expressions.zh: 我们真正拥有的最后领地

writing.title: Preparing Ourselves for the Future
writing.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 10 minutes to write a short essay of about 100-120 words on how college students should prepare for an uncertain future. Describe the changes ahead and suggest qualities worth cultivating.
writing.promptZh: 描述未来的不确定性与变化，论述大学生应培养哪些品质以迎接未来。
outline: 第一段：未来充满不确定——AI重塑职业、变化成为常态
第二段：应培养的品质（学习力、适应力、跨领域整合、人文关怀）
第三段：结语——与其预测未来，不如装备自己
writing.model: No one can predict what the job market will look like in twenty years, as artificial intelligence keeps rewriting the rules of work. Many occupations will disappear, and many more will be born. Faced with such uncertainty, memorizing fixed knowledge is no longer enough. Instead, we should cultivate four lasting qualities. First, the ability to learn — how quickly we master new fields matters more than what we already know. Second, adaptability, the courage to restart when circumstances change. Third, the skill of connecting different disciplines, for innovation lives at crossroads. Fourth, and perhaps most importantly, humanity: empathy, ethics and communication are precisely what machines cannot copy. The best way to predict the future, as Peter Drucker said, is to create it. Let us prepare not for a specific job, but for a lifetime of change.

expressions.en: The best way to predict the future is to create it.
expressions.zh: 预测未来最好的方式是创造未来。

translation.title: The Spring Festival
translation.source: 春节是中国最重要的传统节日，通常在农历一月或二月。节日期间，全家人聚在一起吃团圆饭，孩子们还能收到压岁钱。
translation.ref: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China, which usually falls in January or February of the lunar calendar. During the festival, the whole family get together to enjoy a reunion dinner, and children can also receive lucky money.
points: which 引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明春节的时间
fall in 表示节日'落在'某时间，比 be in 更地道
the lunar calendar 前需加定冠词 the

translation.title: The Mid-Autumn Festival
translation.source: 中秋节在农历八月十五，是家人团聚的日子。人们一边赏月，一边吃月饼，月饼圆圆的形状象征着团圆。
translation.ref: The Mid-Autumn Festival falls on the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month, which is a day for family reunion. People admire the moon while eating mooncakes, and the round shape of the mooncake symbolizes reunion.
points: fall on 后接具体日期，注意与 fall in 的区别
while eating 用现在分词作时间状语，表示两个动作同时进行
symbolize 是及物动词，后直接接宾语，不加 for

translation.title: The Dragon Boat Festival
translation.source: 端午节是为了纪念中国古代诗人屈原而设立的。每年这一天，人们会举行龙舟比赛，并吃一种用竹叶包裹糯米做成的粽子。
translation.ref: The Dragon Boat Festival was established in memory of Qu Yuan, an ancient Chinese poet. On this day every year, people hold dragon boat races and eat zongzi, a kind of sticky rice dumpling wrapped in bamboo leaves.
points: in memory of 表'为纪念……'，是固定搭配
wrapped in bamboo leaves 过去分词短语作后置定语，表被动
同位语 a kind of... 用来解释 zongzi 是什么，避免生硬直译

translation.title: The Lantern Festival
translation.source: 元宵节标志着春节庆祝活动的结束。这一天，人们吃元宵、赏花灯，许多地方还会举办猜灯谜活动。
translation.ref: The Lantern Festival marks the end of the Spring Festival celebrations. On this day, people eat sweet rice balls, enjoy festive lanterns, and many places also hold activities of guessing lantern riddles.
points: mark 用一般现在时表客观事实，主语为节日（无灵主语）
and 连接的两个分句主语不同，many places 前需重新给出主语
guessing lantern riddles 动名词作介词 of 的宾语

translation.title: Tea Culture
translation.source: 中国是茶的故乡，茶文化已有几千年的历史。对许多中国人来说，喝茶不仅能解渴，更是一种放松和社交的方式。
translation.ref: China is the hometown of tea, and tea culture has a history of thousands of years. For many Chinese people, drinking tea not only quenches their thirst, but is also a way of relaxation and socializing.
points: have a history of... 表'有……的历史'，是翻译'历史悠久'的常用句型
not only... but also... 连接两个并列谓语，注意主语 drinking tea 为第三人称单数
a way of doing 中 of 后接动名词

translation.title: Dumplings
translation.source: 饺子在中国已有一千八百多年的历史，是北方人过年时必不可少的食物。饺子的形状像古代的元宝，因此吃饺子寓意着招财进宝。
translation.ref: Dumplings have a history of more than 1,800 years in China and are an essential food for northerners during the Spring Festival. Shaped like ancient gold ingots, dumplings symbolize attracting wealth and treasure.
points: Shaped like... 过去分词短语作状语，其逻辑主语须与主句主语 dumplings 一致
an essential food for... 介词 for 引出适用对象
北方人译为 northerners，避免直译 people in the north 的啰嗦

translation.title: Hot Pot
translation.source: 火锅是最受中国人欢迎的餐饮方式之一，尤其在寒冷的冬天。食客们围坐在热气腾腾的锅旁，把肉片和蔬菜放进汤里涮着吃。
translation.ref: Hot pot is one of the most popular ways of dining among Chinese people, especially in cold winter. Diners sit around a steaming pot and rinse sliced meat and vegetables in the boiling soup.
points: one of the most popular + 复数名词，谓语动词用单数
among 表'在……之中'，用于人群
sit around 和 rinse 由 and 连接，时态保持一致用一般现在时

translation.title: Paper Cutting
translation.source: 剪纸是中国最古老的民间艺术之一，可以追溯到公元六世纪。人们常用剪纸装饰门窗，以表达对新年的美好祝愿。
translation.ref: Paper cutting is one of the oldest folk arts in China, which can date back to the sixth century AD. People often use paper cuttings to decorate doors and windows to express their best wishes for the New Year.
points: date back to 无被动语态，且用于一般现在时
use sth. to do sth. 表目的；句末 to express... 也是不定式作目的状语
wishes for... 介词 for 引出祝愿的对象

translation.title: Chinese Calligraphy
translation.source: 书法是中国特有的一种传统艺术，与绘画、诗歌关系密切。练习书法不仅能让人写得一手好字，还能培养耐心和专注力。
translation.ref: Calligraphy is a traditional art form unique to China and is closely related to painting and poetry. Practicing calligraphy not only helps people write well, but also cultivates patience and concentration.
points: unique to China 形容词短语作后置定语修饰 art form
Practicing calligraphy 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数
cultivate patience 搭配地道，避免 train patience 的中式英语

translation.title: Peking Opera
translation.source: 京剧被称为中国的'国粹'，已有两百多年的历史。它融合了唱、念、做、打等多种表演形式，其华丽的服装和脸谱深受观众喜爱。
translation.ref: Peking Opera is known as the "national essence" of China and has a history of more than 200 years. It combines singing, speaking, acting and acrobatics, and its gorgeous costumes and facial makeup are deeply loved by the audience.
points: be known as 后接称号，be known for 后接原因，注意区分
singing, speaking... 动名词并列作 combines 的宾语
are deeply loved by 被动语态，by 引出动作发出者

translation.title: The Great Wall
translation.source: 长城始建于两千多年前，是世界上最伟大的建筑之一。它蜿蜒于崇山峻岭之间，每年吸引着数以百万计的国内外游客。
translation.ref: The Great Wall was first built more than 2,000 years ago and is one of the greatest buildings in the world. Winding through mountains and ridges, it attracts millions of visitors from home and abroad every year.
points: was first built 一般过去时的被动语态，ago 常与过去时连用
Winding through... 现在分词短语作状语，表主动和伴随
from home and abroad 固定表达'国内外'，不说 from home and foreign countries

translation.title: The Palace Museum
translation.source: 故宫又称紫禁城，是明清两代二十四位皇帝的皇宫。如今它已成为一座著名的博物馆，收藏着大量珍贵的文物。
translation.ref: The Palace Museum, also known as the Forbidden City, served as the imperial palace for 24 emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties. Today it has become a famous museum, housing a large number of precious cultural relics.
points: also known as... 过去分词短语作插入语，前后加逗号
served as 用一般过去时，与下句现在完成时 has become 形成时间对比
housing... 现在分词作伴随状语，补充说明博物馆的功能

translation.title: Giant Pandas
translation.source: 大熊猫是中国的国宝，主要生活在四川、陕西等地的山区。它们以竹子为主食，每天要花十多个小时进食。
translation.ref: Giant pandas are the national treasure of China and mainly live in mountainous areas in Sichuan and Shaanxi. They feed mainly on bamboo and spend more than ten hours a day eating.
points: feed on 表'以……为食'，主动形式表被动意义
spend + 时间 + (in) doing 是固定句型，eating 用动名词
more than ten hours a day 中 a day 表'每天'，用不定冠词

translation.title: High-Speed Rail
translation.source: 中国高铁发展迅速，运营里程已居世界第一。高铁快捷舒适，极大地缩短了城市之间的旅行时间，改变了人们的生活方式。
translation.ref: China's high-speed railway has developed rapidly, and its operating mileage ranks first in the world. Fast and comfortable, high-speed trains have greatly shortened travel time between cities and changed people's way of life.
points: Fast and comfortable 形容词短语作状语（或视为前置的补充说明），主语须为 high-speed trains
现在完成时 have shortened 表过去的动作对现在造成的影响
between cities 表两者/多者'之间'用 between，泛指城市两两之间

translation.title: Mobile Payment
translation.source: 如今，移动支付在中国非常普及，人们出门购物甚至不用带钱包。只需用手机扫一扫二维码，付款就完成了。
translation.ref: Nowadays, mobile payment is very popular in China, and people do not even need to take a wallet when going shopping. They only need to scan a QR code with their mobile phones, and the payment will be completed.
points: when going shopping 省略了主语 they，状语从句的省略要求主语一致
need to do 后接不定式；even 的位置放在 need 之前更自然
will be completed 一般将来时的被动语态

translation.title: Bike Sharing
translation.source: 共享单车近年来出现在中国许多城市的大街小巷。它环保便捷，为人们的短途出行提供了一种新的选择。
translation.ref: In recent years, shared bikes have appeared in the streets and lanes of many Chinese cities. Environmentally friendly and convenient, they provide a new choice for people's short-distance travel.
points: In recent years 常与现在完成时连用，故用 have appeared
形容词短语 Environmentally friendly and convenient 作状语，逻辑主语是 they
provide sth. for sb. 或 provide sb. with sth.，注意介词搭配

translation.title: Online Shopping
translation.source: 网购已经成为中国人日常生活的一部分，各种商品应有尽有。每年'双十一'期间，数以亿计的订单在网上产生。
translation.ref: Online shopping has become part of Chinese people's daily life, where all kinds of goods are available. During the annual "Double Eleven", hundreds of millions of orders are placed online.
points: where 引导定语从句，先行词是抽象'场合'时可用 where
place an order 是固定搭配，'下订单'不说 do an order
hundreds of millions of 注意 hundred/million 前有具体数字时不加 s，此处泛指用复数

translation.title: Food Delivery
translation.source: 外卖服务在中国城市发展很快，年轻人尤其喜欢点外卖。无论工作多忙，他们都能在手机上轻松订到热腾腾的饭菜。
translation.ref: Food delivery services are developing rapidly in Chinese cities, and young people in particular like ordering takeout food. No matter how busy they are with work, they can easily order hot meals on their mobile phones.
points: No matter how + 形容词 + 主语 + 谓语，引导让步状语从句
like doing 表习惯性爱好；in particular 作插入语表强调
on their mobile phones 用介词 on 表'通过手机'

translation.title: Views on Education
translation.source: 中国家长历来重视子女的教育，愿意为孩子的学习投入大量时间和金钱。越来越多的家长认识到，培养孩子的兴趣比分数更重要。
translation.ref: Chinese parents have always attached great importance to their children's education and are willing to invest a lot of time and money in their studies. More and more parents have realized that developing children's interests is more important than scores.
points: attach great importance to 是高频固定搭配，to 为介词
invest... in... 注意介词 in 的搭配
that 引导宾语从句，从句主语为动名词短语，谓语用单数 is

translation.title: Family Values
translation.source: 在中国人的传统观念里，家庭占据着极其重要的地位。无论走多远，人们都牵挂着家人，春节时更要回家团聚。
translation.ref: In the traditional concept of Chinese people, family occupies an extremely important position. No matter how far they go, people always care about their families and are even more eager to go home for reunion during the Spring Festival.
points: No matter how far they go 让步状语从句，主句不省略主语
occupy an important position 是'占重要地位'的直译但地道的表达
be eager to do 表'渴望做某事'，比 want to 更正式

translation.title: Physical Exercise
translation.source: 随着生活水平的提高，越来越多的中国人开始重视体育锻炼。清晨的公园里，常常能看到跑步、打太极拳的人们。
translation.ref: With the improvement of living standards, more and more Chinese people have begun to pay attention to physical exercise. In parks early in the morning, people running and practicing Tai Chi can often be seen.
points: With + 名词短语作伴随状语，是'随着……'的经典译法
running and practicing 现在分词作后置定语修饰 people
can often be seen 情态动词的被动语态，频率副词 often 放在 be 与过去分词之间

translation.title: Square Dancing
translation.source: 广场舞在中国中老年妇女中非常流行，已成为城市的一道独特风景。参与者伴着音乐起舞，既锻炼了身体，又交到了朋友。
translation.ref: Square dancing is very popular among middle-aged and elderly women in China and has become a unique scene in cities. Participants dance to the music, which not only builds up their bodies but also helps them make friends.
points: among 用于三者以上群体之中
dance to the music 中 to 表'伴随、按照'，是固定搭配
which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面整个句子

translation.title: The Travel Boom
translation.source: 近年来，旅游在中国越来越受欢迎，成为人们休闲的重要方式。假期里，各大景区常常挤满了来自全国各地的游客。
translation.ref: In recent years, travel has become increasingly popular in China and an important way for people to spend their leisure time. During holidays, scenic spots are often crowded with tourists from all over the country.
points: In recent years 与现在完成时连用，has become
be crowded with 表'挤满'，用被动形式表达状态
and 后省略了 has become，与 an important way 并列时需补出逻辑

translation.title: Museums and the Public
translation.source: 如今，逛博物馆已成为许多中国人的休闲新选择，尤其在年轻人中间。各大博物馆纷纷推出文创产品，让文物'活'了起来。
translation.ref: Nowadays, visiting museums has become a new leisure choice for many Chinese people, especially among the young. Museums across the country have launched cultural and creative products, making cultural relics "come alive".
points: visiting museums 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数
making... 现在分词作结果状语
使役用法 make sth. do，'活起来'译作 come alive

translation.title: Silk
translation.source: 中国是世界上最早养蚕织丝的国家，丝绸生产已有五千年的历史。古代中国的丝绸通过丝绸之路远销到西方各国。
translation.ref: China was the first country in the world to raise silkworms and weave silk, with a history of 5,000 years of silk production. In ancient times, Chinese silk was sold to Western countries through the Silk Road.
points: the first + 名词 + to do 不定式作后置定语
with a history of... 独立主格式的 with 结构作补充说明
was sold to 一般过去时的被动语态，through 表途径

translation.title: Chopsticks
translation.source: 筷子是中国人发明的独特餐具，使用历史超过三千年。使用筷子需要手指的灵活配合，外国朋友往往要练习很久才能用得熟练。
translation.ref: Chopsticks are unique eating utensils invented by the Chinese, with a history of more than 3,000 years. Using chopsticks requires flexible coordination of the fingers, so foreign friends often have to practice for a long time before they can use them skillfully.
points: chopsticks 通常用复数，谓语动词也用复数
invented by... 过去分词作后置定语表被动
before 引导时间状语从句，主句用 have to practice 表必要

translation.title: The 24 Solar Terms
translation.source: 二十四节气是中国古人根据太阳运行规律发明的时间体系，用来指导农业生产。它至今仍影响着中国人的日常生活和饮食习惯。
translation.ref: The 24 solar terms are a time system created by ancient Chinese people according to the movement of the sun, which is used to guide agricultural production. They still influence Chinese people's daily life and eating habits today.
points: according to 表'根据'，后接名词短语
which is used to 非限制性定语从句修饰 time system
created by 过去分词作定语；第二句主语 They 指代 solar terms，谓语用复数

translation.title: Kite Flying
translation.source: 放风筝是中国传统的民间活动，山东潍坊被称为'风筝之都'。春天一到，人们便来到郊外，把各式各样的风筝放上蓝天。
translation.ref: Kite flying is a traditional folk activity in China, and Weifang in Shandong Province is known as the "capital of kites". As soon as spring arrives, people go to the suburbs and fly various kites into the blue sky.
points: As soon as 引导时间状语从句，从句用一般现在时表将来（主将从现）
be known as 后接称号
fly... into the blue sky 中 into 表方向

translation.title: Online Reading
translation.source: 随着智能手机的普及，越来越多的中国人选择在手机上阅读。电子阅读方便快捷，但也有人担心长时间盯着屏幕会损害视力。
translation.ref: With the popularity of smartphones, more and more Chinese people choose to read on their phones. Electronic reading is convenient and fast, but some people worry that staring at screens for a long time will damage their eyesight.
points: With the popularity of... 名词短语作状语，比 As smartphones become popular 更简洁
worry that 引导宾语从句，从句用一般将来时
staring at screens 动名词短语作从句主语

translation.title: Volunteering
translation.source: 近年来，参加志愿服务在中国年轻人中蔚然成风。志愿者们利用业余时间帮助他人，在奉献社会的同时也提升了自己。
translation.ref: In recent years, taking part in voluntary service has become a trend among young people in China. Volunteers use their spare time to help others, improving themselves while contributing to society.
points: taking part in 动名词短语作主语
improving... 现在分词作伴随状语，逻辑主语是 Volunteers
while contributing to 中 while 后接现在分词，contribute to 的 to 是介词

translation.title: An Aging Society
translation.source: 中国已进入老龄化社会，老年人口比例持续上升，人口结构正在经历深刻转变。为应对这一挑战，各地正加快建设社区养老服务中心，为老年人提供日间照料和紧急救援等服务。
translation.ref: China has entered an aging society, where the proportion of the elderly population keeps rising and the demographic structure is undergoing a profound transition. To meet this challenge, communities across the country are accelerating the construction of old-age care service centers to provide the elderly with day care, emergency rescue services and so on.
points: where 引导定语从句修饰 society，表抽象空间
keep rising 用现在分词表持续进行的动作
To meet this challenge 不定式作目的状语置于句首，后置需加逗号
provide sb. with sth. 双宾语结构，注意介词 with

translation.title: Technology-Empowered Elderly Care
translation.source: 面对家庭的照护压力，科技赋能的养老模式正悄然兴起。智能穿戴设备可以实时监测独居老人的健康状况，一旦发生意外便自动报警，让他们在晚年生活中更有尊严。
translation.ref: Faced with the caregiving burden on families, technology-empowered elderly care is quietly emerging. Smart wearable devices can monitor the health condition of elderly citizens living alone in real time and automatically send out alarms once an accident occurs, enabling them to live a more dignified life in their later years.
points: Faced with 过去分词短语作状语，表'面对'，be faced with 的分词形式
living alone 现在分词作后置定语修饰 citizens
once 引导条件状语从句，用一般现在时表将来
enabling... 现在分词作结果状语，live a... life 是同源宾语搭配

translation.title: The Greater Bay Area
translation.source: 经过近二十年的发展，粤港澳大湾区已成为充满活力的世界级城市群。这里拥有完善的交通网络和得天独厚的区位优势，正朝着国际一流湾区的目标稳步迈进。

hints.en: the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area

hints.zh: 充满活力的世界级城市群

hints.en: a world-class bay area of international stature

translation.ref: After nearly two decades of development, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area has become a dynamic world-class city cluster. Boasting well-developed transport networks and superb locational advantages, the area is striding steadily toward its goal of becoming a world-class bay area of international stature.
points: two decades of development 用 decade 表达'十年'比 ten years 更正式
Boasting... 现在分词作状语，boast 表'拥有（值得自豪的事物）'
striding toward 用现在进行时表正在进行的趋势
its goal of becoming 介词 of 后接动名词作同位语

translation.title: Lunar Exploration
translation.source: 近年来，中国探月工程取得了一系列举世瞩目的成就，'嫦娥'探测器成功实现了月球背面软着陆。按计划，登月配套设施的建设正在全力推进，为未来的载人登月奠定坚实基础。

hints.en: the far side of the moon
supporting facilities for a lunar landing

translation.ref: In recent years, China's lunar exploration program has achieved a series of world-renowned accomplishments, with the Chang'e probes successfully making a soft landing on the far side of the moon. As scheduled, the construction of supporting facilities for a lunar landing is being fully advanced, laying a solid foundation for future manned lunar missions.
points: with + 名词 + doing 独立主格结构作伴随状语，是高分句型
make a soft landing on 注意冠词 a 和介词 on 的搭配
is being fully advanced 现在进行时的被动语态
laying... 现在分词作结果状语；lay 的过去式为 laid

translation.title: The BeiDou System
translation.source: 北斗卫星导航系统是中国自主建设运行的全球卫星导航系统，已广泛应用于交通、农业和救灾等诸多领域。它的建成标志着中国在航天技术方面迈出了重要一步。

hints.en: be widely applied to / used in

translation.ref: Independently developed and operated by China, the BeiDou Navigation Satellite System has been widely applied to such fields as transportation, agriculture and disaster relief. Its completion marks an important step taken by China in space technology.
points: Independently developed and operated by... 过去分词短语作状语置于句首，表被动，逻辑主语须为系统本身
such... as... 列举结构
marks 一般现在时表客观事实；an important step taken by 过去分词作后置定语

translation.title: The Space Station
translation.source: 中国空间站已进入长期有人驻留的应用发展阶段，航天员乘组定期轮换，开展大量空间科学实验。这为人类和平利用太空作出了重要贡献。
translation.ref: China's space station has entered the stage of application and development with a long-term crewed presence, where crews of astronauts rotate regularly and conduct a large number of space science experiments. This has made an important contribution to the peaceful use of outer space by humanity.
points: with a long-term crewed presence 介词短语作定语，crewed 是航天领域'载人的'标准用词
where 引导定语从句修饰 the stage，表抽象场所
make a contribution to 中 to 是介词，后接名词
This 指代前面整句话的内容

translation.title: Commercial Aerospace
translation.source: 商业航天正成为中国航天事业的新引擎，多家公司在降低太空发射成本方面取得了突破性进展。随着可重复使用火箭技术的成熟，普通人的太空旅游梦想或许并不遥远。
translation.ref: Commercial aerospace is becoming a new engine for China's space endeavors, with several companies making breakthrough progress in reducing space launch costs. With the maturity of reusable rocket technology, the dream of space tourism for ordinary people may not be far away.
points: with + 名词 + doing 独立主格结构作状语
make progress in doing 中 in 是介词，后接动名词
With the maturity of... 名词化表达，比 When... becomes mature 更简洁正式

translation.title: AI and Production
translation.source: 人工智能正以前所未有的速度融入工业制造的各个环节，极大地提高了生产效率。与此同时，它也引发了人们对就业结构变化的担忧，如何实现人机协作成为亟待解决的课题。
translation.ref: Artificial intelligence is being integrated into every link of industrial manufacturing at an unprecedented pace, which has vastly improved production efficiency. Meanwhile, it has also aroused people's concerns about changes in the employment structure, and how to achieve human-machine collaboration has become a pressing issue to be solved.
points: is being integrated into 现在进行时的被动语态，表正在发生的趋势
which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面整个句子
arouse concerns about 是'引发对……的担忧'的地道搭配
how to achieve... 疑问词+不定式作主语，谓语用单数 has become

translation.title: The Smart Economy
translation.source: 中国正致力于打造'智能经济'新形态，以新质生产力推动高质量发展。多所高校相继组建人工智能学院，旨在抢占国际科技竞争的战略制高点。

hints.en: be devoted to / be committed to

translation.ref: China is devoted to forging a new form of "smart economy", driving high-quality development with new quality productive forces. A number of universities have successively established artificial intelligence colleges, aiming to seize the strategic high ground in international technological competition.
points: be devoted to 中 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词
driving... 现在分词作方式状语
have successively established 现在完成时，副词 successively 的位置放在实义动词之前
aiming to do 现在分词作目的状语

translation.title: Jingdezhen Porcelain
translation.source: 景德镇素有'瓷都'之称，其手工制瓷技艺传承千年，精美的瓷器曾通过海上丝绸之路远销世界各地。如今，景德镇手工瓷业遗存正申请世界遗产，这张亮丽的文化名片被推向世界文化交流的舞台中心。

hints.en: be known as / enjoy the reputation of

translation.ref: Known as the "porcelain capital", Jingdezhen boasts handmade porcelain craftsmanship passed down for thousands of years, and its exquisite porcelain was once exported to all parts of the world via the Maritime Silk Road. Today, the handmade porcelain industry heritage of Jingdezhen is applying for World Heritage status, and this splendid cultural calling card is being propelled to the center stage of global cultural exchange.
points: Known as... 过去分词短语作状语置于句首，逻辑主语须是 Jingdezhen
boast 表'拥有（引以为豪的东西）'，pass down 用过去分词 passed down 作后置定语
be exported to... via... 被动语态，via 表途径
is being propelled 现在进行时的被动语态，propel to 表'推向'

translation.title: Carbon Peaking and Neutrality
translation.source: 中国正积极稳妥地推进碳达峰、碳中和，全面大力发展绿色低碳经济。重点行业的节能降碳行动成效显著，大规模生态保护修复工程也在稳步推进。

hints.en: in an active yet prudent manner

translation.ref: China is promoting carbon peaking and carbon neutrality in an active yet prudent manner, and vigorously developing a green and low-carbon economy across the board. Energy conservation and carbon reduction in key industries have achieved remarkable results, and large-scale ecological protection and restoration projects are also being advanced steadily.
points: in an active yet prudent manner 中 yet 连接两个形容词，表'而'
across the board 表'全面地'，是副词性固定短语
have achieved 现在完成时表已取得的结果
are being advanced steadily 现在进行时的被动语态

translation.title: Hydrogen Energy Application
translation.source: 中国启动了首个十万户级的天然气掺氢应用项目，依托现有管网大幅降低了氢能规模化应用的基础设施成本。这些前瞻性举措向世界展示了经济增长与环境保护协同发展的可行路径。
translation.ref: China has launched the first 100,000-household natural gas hydrogen-blending application project, which has significantly lowered the infrastructure cost of large-scale hydrogen application by relying on the existing pipeline network. These forward-looking measures show the world a viable path for the coordinated development of economic growth and environmental protection.
points: 100,000-household 数词与名词用连字符构成复合形容词，名词不加 s
which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面的项目
by relying on 介词 by 后接动名词表方式
show sb. sth. 双宾语结构

translation.title: Manufacturing Upgrading
translation.source: 在当前复杂的全球经济格局下，保持制造业的合理比重对保障国家经济安全至关重要。中国正加速推进传统产业的数智化转型，生产制造流程加速蜕变为'无人工厂'和'智能车间'。
translation.ref: Amid the current complex global economic landscape, maintaining a reasonable share of manufacturing is crucial to safeguarding national economic security. China is accelerating the digital and intelligent transformation of traditional industries, and production and manufacturing processes are rapidly evolving into "unmanned factories" and "smart workshops".
points: Amid 介词表'在……之中'，比 In 更正式
maintaining... 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 is
be crucial to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词 safeguarding
evolve into 表'演变成'，用现在进行时 are evolving 表趋势

translation.title: The Mogao Caves
translation.source: 敦煌莫高窟以精美的壁画和塑像闻名于世，见证了古代丝绸之路上东西方文明的交流互鉴。数字化技术的应用让这一千年瑰宝得以永久保存，并向全球观众敞开大门。
translation.ref: The Mogao Caves in Dunhuang are world-famous for their exquisite murals and statues, witnessing the exchange and mutual learning between Eastern and Western civilizations along the ancient Silk Road. The application of digital technology enables this thousand-year-old treasure to be preserved permanently and opened to audiences around the world.
points: be famous for 表'因……而闻名'
witnessing 现在分词作伴随状语，石窟作为无灵主语'见证'历史
enable sth. to be done 使役结构中用不定式的被动式
thousand-year-old 复合形容词，名词用单数并加连字符

translation.title: The Grand Canal
translation.source: 中国大运河是世界上开凿最早、里程最长的人工运河，千百年来滋养着沿岸的经济与文化。2014年，大运河成功列入《世界遗产名录》，成为全人类共同的文化财富。

hints.en: be inscribed on the World Heritage List

translation.ref: The Grand Canal is the man-made canal that was excavated earliest and stretches longest in the world, nourishing the economy and culture along its banks for thousands of years. In 2014, it was successfully inscribed on the World Heritage List, becoming a shared cultural treasure of all humanity.
points: that was excavated earliest 定语从句修饰 canal，最高级含义用 earliest 表达
nourishing... 现在分词作伴随状语，for thousands of years 常与完成时呼应，此处描述持续功能
be inscribed on 是申遗语境的标准被动搭配
becoming... 现在分词作结果状语

translation.title: Traditional Chinese Medicine
translation.source: 中医药是中华民族数千年实践经验的结晶，强调阴阳平衡与整体调理。近年来，针灸、推拿等疗法越来越受到国际社会认可，中医药正加速走向世界。
translation.ref: Traditional Chinese medicine is the crystallization of thousands of years of practical experience of the Chinese nation, emphasizing the balance between yin and yang as well as holistic regulation. In recent years, therapies such as acupuncture and tuina massage have gained increasing recognition from the international community, and traditional Chinese medicine is accelerating its steps to the world.
points: emphasizing... 现在分词作伴随状语
as well as 连接并列成分，相当于 and，但更正式
have gained recognition from 现在完成时表已产生的影响
such as 举例时前不加逗号，列举内容紧跟其后

translation.title: Poverty Alleviation
translation.source: 中国完成了消除绝对贫困的艰巨任务，近一亿农村贫困人口实现脱贫，创造了人类减贫史上的奇迹。这一成就的取得，离不开产业扶贫、教育扶贫等多种举措的共同发力。
translation.ref: China has accomplished the arduous task of eliminating absolute poverty, with nearly 100 million rural poor people lifted out of poverty, creating a miracle in the history of human poverty reduction. This achievement would not have been made without the joint efforts of various measures such as poverty alleviation through industry and education.
points: accomplish the task of doing 中 of 是介词，后接动名词
with + 名词 + 过去分词 lifted 独立主格结构，表被动含义
would not have been made without... 含蓄虚拟条件句，表示与过去事实相反
creating... 现在分词作结果状语

translation.title: Rural Revitalization
translation.source: 乡村振兴战略实施以来，中国农村面貌发生了翻天覆地的变化，特色产业和乡村旅游蓬勃发展。越来越多的大学毕业生选择返乡创业，为乡村注入新的活力。
translation.ref: Since the rural revitalization strategy was implemented, earth-shaking changes have taken place in China's countryside, where specialty industries and rural tourism are booming. An increasing number of college graduates choose to return home to start businesses, injecting new vitality into rural areas.
points: Since 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时
take place 表'发生'，无被动语态
where 引导定语从句修饰 countryside
an increasing number of + 复数名词，谓语用复数 choose；injecting 现在分词作结果状语

translation.title: The Digital Economy
translation.source: 数字经济已成为中国经济增长的新引擎，其规模位居世界前列。从电子商务到智能制造，数字技术催生了众多新的业态，深刻改变着人们的生产生活方式。

hints.en: rank among the top in the world

translation.ref: The digital economy has become a new engine for China's economic growth, ranking among the top in the world in terms of scale. From e-commerce to intelligent manufacturing, digital technologies have catalyzed numerous new business formats, profoundly changing the way people work and live.
points: ranking among the top 现在分词作伴随状语
in terms of 表'在……方面'，是六级高频介词短语
From... to... 介词结构表范围
the way (that) people work and live 中 way 后接省略 that 的定语从句

translation.title: Livestreaming E-Commerce in Rural Areas
translation.source: 直播带货让偏远地区的农产品走出大山、直达全国消费者的餐桌。手机成为'新农具'，直播成为'新农活'，数字经济正为乡村振兴开辟新路径。
translation.ref: Livestreaming e-commerce has enabled agricultural products from remote areas to reach beyond the mountains and go straight to the tables of consumers nationwide. Mobile phones have become "new farming tools" and livestreaming a "new farming job", as the digital economy is opening up a new path for rural revitalization.
points: enable sb./sth. to do 使役结构
nationwide 作后置定语修饰 consumers，比 all over the country 更简洁
livestreaming a 'new farming job' 省略了 have become，避免重复
as 引导原因状语从句，置于句末不加逗号也可，此处加逗号更清晰

translation.title: The Global Chinese Language Boom
translation.source: 随着中国国际影响力的提升，全球'汉语热'持续升温，学习汉语的外国人数不断攀升。语言是文明交流的桥梁，汉语的普及增进了世界各国人民对中国的了解。

hints.en: continue to heat up / gain momentum

translation.ref: With the rise of China's international influence, the global "Chinese language boom" continues to heat up, and the number of foreigners learning Chinese keeps climbing. Language is a bridge for the exchange of civilizations, and the spread of Chinese has enhanced people's understanding of China across the world.
points: With the rise of... 名词短语作状语
the number of + 复数名词作主语时谓语用单数
learning Chinese 现在分词作后置定语修饰 foreigners
has enhanced 现在完成时表已经产生的影响；across the world 作后置定语

translation.title: Intangible Cultural Heritage
translation.source: 中国是世界上非物质文化遗产最丰富的国家之一，现有四十多个项目列入联合国教科文组织名录。让非遗走进现代生活，在传承中创新，是其保持生命力的关键。

hints.en: innovate in the process of inheritance

translation.ref: China is one of the countries with the richest intangible cultural heritage in the world, with more than 40 items inscribed on the UNESCO lists. Making intangible cultural heritage enter modern life and innovating in the process of inheritance are the key to maintaining its vitality.
points: one of the countries with... 介词短语作后置定语
with + 名词 + 过去分词 inscribed 独立主格结构，表被动
两个动名词短语并列作主语时，谓语用复数 are
the key to doing 中 to 是介词，后接动名词

translation.title: Ecological Civilization
translation.source: 生态文明建设正在深刻改变中国的发展方式，'绿水青山就是金山银山'的理念深入人心。各地关停污染企业、恢复湿地植被，天更蓝、水更清的生态画卷正徐徐展开。

hints.zh: 绿水青山就是金山银山
hints.en: lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets

translation.ref: The building of ecological civilization is profoundly changing China's mode of development, and the idea that "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets" has taken root in people's hearts. As localities shut down polluting enterprises and restore wetland vegetation, an ecological picture featuring bluer skies and clearer waters is slowly unrolling.
points: the idea that... 同位语从句，that 不充当成分只起连接作用
has taken root 现在完成时表状态已经形成
As 引导时间状语从句，表'随着'
featuring... 现在分词作后置定语修饰 picture；is unrolling 用进行时表生动画面

translation.title: The Belt and Road Initiative
translation.source: '一带一路'倡议提出以来，中国已与一百五十多个国家和国际组织签署合作文件。这一倡议促进了沿线国家的互联互通，为共同发展注入了强劲动力。
translation.ref: Since the Belt and Road Initiative was put forward, China has signed cooperation documents with more than 150 countries and international organizations. The initiative has promoted connectivity among countries along the routes and injected strong momentum into common development.
points: Since 从句用一般过去时的被动语态 was put forward，主句用现在完成时
more than 150 countries 中 more than 修饰数词表'超过'
among 用于三者以上；along the routes 作后置定语
promoted 和 injected 由 and 连接，共用助动词 has

translation.title: The Maritime Silk Road
translation.source: 海上丝绸之路起源于秦汉时期，繁荣于唐宋，是古代中国与外国贸易和文化交往的海上通道。瓷器、丝绸和茶叶顺着这条航线远渡重洋，也带回了异域的商品与文明。
translation.ref: The Maritime Silk Road, which originated in the Qin and Han dynasties and flourished in the Tang and Song dynasties, was a maritime passage for trade and cultural exchanges between ancient China and foreign countries. Porcelain, silk and tea crossed the oceans along this route, which also brought back goods and civilizations from foreign lands.
points: which originated... and flourished... 非限制性定语从句作插入成分，主句谓语 was 在其后
for trade and cultural exchanges 介词短语表用途
along this route 作方式状语；which also brought back 定语从句修饰 route
bring back 表'带回'，可分动词短语

translation.title: The Guochao Trend
translation.source: '国潮'兴起，中国传统元素与现代设计巧妙融合，深受年轻消费者青睐。从汉服热到文创产品，国潮的流行折射出年轻一代日益增强的文化自信。
translation.ref: With the rise of the "Guochao" trend, traditional Chinese elements are cleverly integrated with modern designs, which are greatly favored by young consumers. From the Hanfu craze to cultural and creative products, the popularity of Guochao reflects the growing cultural confidence of the younger generation.
points: With the rise of... 名词短语作状语
are integrated with 被动语态，integrate A with B 表'把 A 与 B 结合'
which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面整个主句内容
From... to... 表范围；the growing cultural confidence 现在分词作定语

translation.title: Protecting the Yangtze River
translation.source: 长江是中华民族的母亲河，也曾因过度开发而生态告急。如今，十年禁渔等举措使长江流域生物多样性逐步恢复，江豚的身影再次频现江面。
translation.ref: The Yangtze River, the mother river of the Chinese nation, once faced an ecological crisis due to over-exploitation. Nowadays, measures such as the ten-year fishing ban have gradually restored biodiversity in the Yangtze River basin, and Yangtze finless porpoises are frequently seen on the river again.
points: the mother river of... 作 The Yangtze River 的同位语，前后加逗号
due to 表原因，后接名词短语
have gradually restored 现在完成时，副词 gradually 放在实义动词前
are frequently seen 被动语态，频率副词放在 be 与过去分词之间

translation.title: The Terracotta Army
translation.source: 秦始皇陵兵马俑被誉为'世界第八大奇迹'，每个陶俑的面容、发式和铠甲都各不相同。它的发现为研究秦代军事、艺术和社会生活提供了极其珍贵的实物资料。

hints.en: the Terracotta Army of Emperor Qinshihuang's Mausoleum

translation.ref: The Terracotta Army of Emperor Qinshihuang's Mausoleum is hailed as the "eighth wonder of the world", and no two warriors share the same facial features, hairstyles or armor. Its discovery has provided extremely precious physical evidence for the study of the military, art and social life of the Qin Dynasty.
points: be hailed as 表'被誉为'，比 be called 更正式
no two warriors share the same... 否定结构表达'各不相同'，避免生硬的 are different from each other
has provided 现在完成时表对现在的影响；for the study of 表用途

translation.title: Mount Tai
translation.source: 泰山位于山东省中部，主峰海拔1545米，素有'五岳之首'的美誉。数千年来，泰山一直是帝王祭祀天地的圣地，'重于泰山'的说法早已融入中国人的精神世界。

hints.en: the foremost of the Five Sacred Mountains
offer sacrifices to heaven and earth

translation.ref: Located in the central part of Shandong Province, Mount Tai has a main peak rising 1,545 meters above sea level and enjoys the reputation of being the foremost of the Five Sacred Mountains. For thousands of years, it has been a sacred place where emperors offered sacrifices to heaven and earth, and the saying "weightier than Mount Tai" has long been integrated into the spiritual world of the Chinese people.
points: Located in... 过去分词短语作状语置于句首，逻辑主语为 Mount Tai
enjoy the reputation of being 中 of 是介词，后接动名词
where 引导定语从句修饰 sacred place
has long been integrated into 现在完成时被动语态，long 插入助动词之间

translation.title: The Four Great Inventions
translation.source: 造纸术、印刷术、火药和指南针被称为中国古代四大发明，深刻影响了世界文明的进程。它们经阿拉伯人传入欧洲后，为文艺复兴和地理大发现创造了重要条件。
translation.ref: Papermaking, printing, gunpowder and the compass are known as the Four Great Inventions of ancient China, which profoundly influenced the course of world civilization. After being introduced to Europe by the Arabs, they created important conditions for the Renaissance and the Age of Discovery.
points: are known as 后接称号；which 非限制性定语从句指代四大发明
After being introduced... 介词后接动名词的被动式 being done，作时间状语
create conditions for 表'为……创造条件'，介词 for 固定搭配
专有名词 the Renaissance 和 the Age of Discovery 前需加定冠词
